interpretation_and_decision_notes.interpretation: WFO-01 through WFO-08 retain their original completed shared-source/shared-release baseline status. That is historical source evidence, not acceptance of the final system, live service or all consumers. Preserve existing implementation and verify only the required repair, regression and adoption delta. All criteria in this delivery ledger start pending final verification.

Use one canonical policy source, Tracker-owned portable frontend/helper closure, a versioned generated/static technical validation contract, one presentation projection and a minimal resource relationship schema plus real UI. This simplifies means only: documentation-only resources, a permanently manual frontend copy, or a design without working behavior do not satisfy the original outcomes. No new resolver framework, universal resource graph or service is required.

Replace the original large dependency barrier with recurring compatible release slices: meaningful feature checks and independent review, immutable Tracker support, exact compatible Master pin, verified skill distribution as applicable, compatible actual reader before new consumer writers/state, and actual activation proof. Original dependencies are retained as source data, not applied as a new mega-release prerequisite. WFO-18/19/24 remain required outcomes on each affected slice and at final acceptance.

Provide a modern owned individual/direct reviewed route with freshness, accepted-scope completion and genuine independent review, without mandatory batch waiting. Stage remains an independent explicitly supported option, not a consequence of source-only completion. A literal direct-to-main preset has Stage off; an individual route with Stage enabled must use its supported reviewed Stage/promotion path rather than bypass it. Preserve Git-only n8n projects with Stage enabled. No fake Approved queue, forced batch migration or perpetual legacy-only route satisfies the requested simple modern workflow.

Identical allowlisted AI Skills mirror synchronization uses a local idempotent sync-operation identity, exact immutable source provenance, complete blob/mode/path/catalog verification and maintained automated PR/publication. It does not require a second authored Issue for the identical copied change and does not pretend a foreign Issue is local. Mixed or original authored work requires ordinary local tracking/review. Automation grants no arbitrary instruction edits or consumer activation.

Task 02 preserves existing Archive semantics until Task 10 explicitly migrates to retention-only archival. Preserve last status, actual outcome/evidence and reason. A completed archived task can satisfy dependencies for its accepted scope; rejected, cancelled, unfinished or unknown archived work cannot. Included unfinished release work stays unresolved unless membership changes explicitly. Account for archive flags/body reasons, old hashes, historical manifests and restore/reopen behavior; no current-body historical rehash. Unknown old outcomes require evidence or a specific D02 resolution, not automatic success.
interpretation_and_decision_notes.owner_decision_required: Only for specific historical cases requiring a new owner acceptance; the retention target itself is specified.

interpretation_and_decision_notes.interpretation: Publication is an explicit completion obligation only where accepted scope requires it. Freeze required target and source/scope identity; merge alone cannot satisfy required standard/plugin/catalog publication. Source-only tooling maintenance need not publish automatically. Progress never substitutes for terminal publication proof. Use prior immutable self-adoption pins or an equivalent documented self-repository exception to avoid circular release dependencies.

Implement an actual measured supported expensive configuration and authenticated per-job mixed-attempt provenance, not indefinite research. Unprovable/mutable/unsupported contexts remain fresh, and installer/runtime acceptance is distinct. Compare benefit against incumbent ACL behavior including verification overhead; corrected double-counting is not newly saved execution. If no safe useful case can be demonstrated, D04 remains open until implemented or explicitly revised by the owner; the full system cannot be declared fully ready meanwhile.
interpretation_and_decision_notes.owner_decision_required: Only if D04 is triggered by demonstrated lack of a safe useful case.
